skill.tmm_monk.monk_root.desc: The first sunset rite awakens your Monk discipline. Choose an early technique using your starting skill point.
message.tmm_monk.sunset_complete: You have completed the First Sunset and become a Monk.
message.tmm_monk.sunset_interrupted: Your meditation did not complete; try again at another sunset.
skill.tmm_monk.open_palm.desc: Your unarmed strikes deal +1 attack damage while you observe the Monk discipline.
skill.tmm_monk.unarmored_poise.desc: Your body gains +2 natural armor while wearing no conventional armor.
skill.tmm_monk.fleet_footwork.desc: You move 5% faster while remaining within the Monk discipline.
message.tmm_monk.rank_up: Monk cultivation advanced to rank %s! New faction skill points are available.
skill.tmm_monk.step_assist.desc: Advanced mobility discipline: step up full blocks without conventional weapons or armor.
skill.tmm_monk.stone_fist.desc: Bare-handed training: harvest pickaxe-mineable stone-tier blocks and mine them faster without tools. Higher ores still require later techniques.
